independent_exhaustive.oracle: direct witness search X<n<=4096 plus output-condition validation

proof_equivalent_invariant: Let y=n xor C. If y<n, remainder X forces y=X, hence witness n=C xor X>X.
If y>n and y-n>=n, the highest set bit of C toggles n upward; since X<n lies below that bit, C xor X>X gives a q=0 witness.
Otherwise 0<=y-n<n and X=y-n=C-2(n&C); therefore s=(C-X)/2 is a bit-subset of C, and n=2^30+s is a valid witness.
The two constructive branches are therefore complete.

independent_exhaustive.oracle: independent exhaustive enumeration of all symmetric Latin squares and induced position-of-symbol-1 mappings

proof_equivalent_invariant: Because every row is a permutation and A is symmetric, the column of symbol 1 defines an involution Y.
For odd N, each color-factor involution has at least one fixed point; the N diagonal cells across N colors force exactly one fixed point per color, so Y must have exactly one fixed point.

Odd sufficiency: embed the target involution as one perfect matching of K_{N+1} using a ghost vertex, conjugate a round-robin 1-factorization so that matching is round 1, then replace each ghost edge by a loop.

Even sufficiency: complete Y to a perfect matching F0 by pairing its fixed vertices; conjugate a 1-factorization of K_N so F0 is round 1, add an all-loop factor, then on each paired fixed-vertex edge perform the symmetric 2x2 trade edge(color1)<->two loops(loop-color).
